newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening firmer on Monday, but much of the market's attention was on LME where the third Wednesday pricing was underway amid sharply tightening spreads and rising stocks.

COMEX September copper was called to open up 0.50 to 1.00 cent a lb from Friday's close at 104.30 cents. September was last traded on overnight ACCESS at 105.80 cents a lb, up 1.50 cents from Friday's close.
The LME backwardation widened out to $205/$215 near COMEX opening, up from $137/$140 at the New York close Friday.
LME stocks rose 2,075 tonnes Monday to 141,200 tonnes.
COMEX stocks Friday fell 995 short tons to 35,454 short tons.
